payload.text: The tap's CI runs brew style and brew audit --strict again (hv's ISSUE:0004 ruling 3). hv's OK to push came on 2026-11-16 ("do it now", decision 9), but the permission check in dc's session refused dc's git push to the tap, so nothing was sent and the tap's main is still cf77911 (dc's ls-remote, 17:39Z). dc tried no other route and asked no seat to push; vc does not push it either. Once 434d105 is on the tap's main: vc tells dc, dc reports the tap's CI on macos-15 and ubuntu-22.04 (dc's hold 14), and on green vc lands b3ca1c1 from dc/tap-ci-docs and archives this.
